ev.q: Eating fresh cheese curds during June 1--17 was reported by all 24 case-patients in Chippewa and Eau Claire counties
Fifteen (50%) of 30 case-patients who recalled the purchase date
27 from Chippewa and 16 from Eau Claire counties
Mean duration of diarrhea was 5.1 and 4.5 days for 25 hospitalized and 30 nonhospitalized case-patients
For each case-patient, two community controls matched by sex and age group
A matched case-control study was conducted to assess potential sources of infection.
This report summarizes the outbreak investigation, which implicated fresh (held <60 days) cheese curds
